MalariaSurveillanceReportAmplicon.data_s: MAD4HATTER v4 amplicon · UCSF mad4hatter outputs (runs 1-10)
##_optional_rendering_levers: all three are optional; see docs/WDL_INTERFACE.md section 4
##_country_iso3: REQUIRED unless the samples really are Senegalese. It defaults to SEN, and any sample whose coordinates fall outside the selected country is dropped - set the wrong country and every sample is dropped and the run fails.
##_sample_set_scoping: Launch against a *_sample_set row and the download is scoped to that set automatically. Set entity_set_type / entity_set_name only to override that.
